description:
Found by fz-kdt.69.3's build: CallTargetSummary.activation_inputs is merged
COLUMN-WISE (merge_callsite_input_vec via same_call_target) while
ActivationInputRow must stay correlated (fz-9i4.7.10.2 -- a row's columns
arrived together and only ever bind a clause together). So even with
fz-kdt.80 fixed, the edge fact cannot replace the contribution channel's row
model as-is. Any demand-from-edges redesign needs a correlated carrier on
the edge value, or keeps a (deduplicated -- fz-kdt.72) contribution channel.
PREREQUISITE-ADJACENT for fz-kdt.69.3.
title: Edge facts cannot carry the correlated input-row model
